items.title: Obtain and renew the applicable food establishment license
items.description: Food establishments operating in this jurisdiction must obtain the applicable state or local food license before operating and renew it as required.

feeDetail.note: Fees vary by establishment type and jurisdiction; confirm the current fee schedule before filing.

lateFee.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.

note: Connecticut county governments were abolished; counties are geographic names only, and local business obligations are administered by towns or cities.
